headline: Why Billionaires Buying T. Rex Skeletons Is a Disaster for Science
reasoning: This topic scores exceptionally high on clickability and mainstream appeal due to the universal fascination with dinosaurs, large sums of money, and a clear conflict between science and wealthy collectors. While it has low direct practical value for the average user, it excels as a thought-provoking explainer on the intersection of tech wealth, culture, and science, and could easily be adapted into several engaging formats.
summary: Sotheby's is auctioning a rare T. rex skeleton for an estimated $30 million, sparking outrage from paleontologists who argue that the growing trend of private collectors buying up important fossils makes them inaccessible for scientific research.

source_articles.title: Sotheby's big T. rex auction raises concerns hype and wealth are upending science
source_articles.excerpt: Private buyers are increasingly outbidding museums for fossils.
